# Cloudflare token scopes

<!-- Generated by `packages/warpmetal-cli/scripts/gen-cloudflare-inventory.mjs`; do not edit by hand. -->

Which API-token permission each shipped tool needs, read from the spec's
`x-api-token-group` (the permission group name the dashboard shows). A token
needs the union of the groups for the tools it calls, within the resource
scope: a zone permission applies to one zone, an account permission to one
account, and the `/user/tokens` tools need a user-scoped token.

An operation that accepts *any* of many permissions is listed under "Accepts
any of" rather than once per group, so a group section means what it says.

```sh
warpmetal env store set cloudflare.token --stdin   # reads the token from stdin
```

## API Tokens Read

Tools (3):
- `cloudflare_user_tokens_list` - `GET` `/user/tokens`
- `cloudflare_user_tokens_get` - `GET` `/user/tokens/{token_id}`
- `cloudflare_user_tokens_permission_groups_list` - `GET` `/user/tokens/permission_groups`

Tools (3):
- `cloudflare_user_tokens_list` - `GET` `/user/tokens`

## Accepts any of many permissions

Cloudflare documents these as usable with any one of a long list of
permissions; the count is how many it accepts.

- `cloudflare_zones_get` - `GET` `/zones/{zone_id}` - any of 36
- `cloudflare_hold_list` - `GET` `/zones/{zone_id}/hold` - any of 36
- `cloudflare_dns_settings_list` - `GET` `/zones/{zone_id}/dns_settings` - any of 4

## Cloudflare's internal permission ids

`x-cfPermissionsRequired` as the API reports it, per tool. These are not the
dashboard names above; they are what a policy document or an error message
quotes back.

- `cloudflare_zones_get`: `#zone:read`
- `cloudflare_zones_delete`: `#zone:edit`
- `cloudflare_dns_records_list`: `#dns_records:read`
- `cloudflare_dns_records_create`: `#dns_records:edit`
- `cloudflare_dns_records_get`: `#dns_records:read`
- `cloudflare_dns_records_update`: `#dns_records:edit`
- `cloudflare_dns_records_replace`: `#dns_records:edit`
- `cloudflare_dns_records_delete`: `#dns_records:edit`
- `cloudflare_dns_records_batch`: `#dns_records:batch`
- `cloudflare_dns_settings_list`: `#dns_records:read`
- `cloudflare_dns_settings_patch`: `#dns_records:edit`
- `cloudflare_dnssec_list`: `#zone_settings:read`
- `cloudflare_dnssec_patch`: `#zone_settings:edit`
- `cloudflare_dnssec_delete`: `#zone_settings:edit`
- `cloudflare_settings_list`: `#zone_settings:read`
- `cloudflare_settings_get`: `#zone_settings:read`
- `cloudflare_settings_update`: `#zone_settings:read`
- `cloudflare_purge_cache`: `#cache_purge:edit`
- `cloudflare_user_tokens_list`: `com.cloudflare.api.token.list`
- `cloudflare_user_tokens_get`: `com.cloudflare.api.token.read`
- `cloudflare_user_tokens_permission_groups_list`: `com.cloudflare.api.token.read`

## Tools with no permission metadata

The spec publishes no token permission for these, so they cannot be filed
under a group above. Their allowlist entry carries the reviewed note:

- `cloudflare_accounts_list` - GET /accounts
- `cloudflare_user_tokens_verify` - GET /user/tokens/verify
